title: Reproduce: Association between triglyceride-glucose related indices and mortality among individuals with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease or metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 38965572 (Association between triglyceride-glucose related indices and mortality among individuals with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease or metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease) using NHANES or its governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the clinical-research workflow of PMID 38965572: Association between triglyceride-glucose related indices and mortality among individuals with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease or metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. Primary endpoint: mortality in NAFLD/MASLD with triglyceride-glucose related indices. Use NHANES or a locked benchmark extract derived from it. Report cohort construction, variables, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.

rediscovery_target: Recover reported discrimination and risk-category movement.
